purpose: Only a later, newly recorded Song-format session may be treated as prospective evidence for the current live four-hand-state model.
selection_rule: No refitting, threshold tuning, or model choice on the candidate session before scoring; report four-state and 28-state endpoints separately.
scope: Eligibility gate only. Passing does not prove electrode re-placement, a new participant, live accuracy, or independent gesture-onset labels.
